name: mothership-sunset
notes: Mothership nautical concept, SUNSET version (Colby, typed 2026-09-08 ~11:10: the four stills redone way prettier, at sunset, stunning cinematography and grading). Same construction as mothership-sea: three Seedance shots chained through the keyframes as first and last frames (K1→K2, K2→K3, K3→K4), one continuous take, then black. Native sea ambience. Keyframes from the sunset chain Colby picks (boards mothership-sunset-gpt / -nbp).

render.prompt: The empty sea in the last golden light of sunset under a vivid double rainbow, thin mist glowing amber over gilded swells; slowly the rainbow softens and a low bank of fog begins to roll in from the left while, on the horizon beneath the rainbow, a tall three-masted 1800s ship of the line appears as a tiny sunlit speck under full sail and begins to approach. Photoreal live-action cinematography, one continuous locked-off shot from a low vantage just above the water; long slow swells, drifting mist, warm amber highlights against cool teal shadows, deep clean blacks, fine film grain, a cinematic grade; the camera does not move; the light stays consistent with the first frame; no people, no text, no logos. Ambient sound only: the sea, a low wind, the distant creak of rigging and a faint ship’s bell.
